Usage: jsn <command> [options]

Command-line interface for ServiceNow

COMMON COMMANDS
  incidents  List, show, create, or update incidents
  requests   Work with requested items
  tasks      Work with catalog tasks
  changes    Work with change requests
  approvals  List, approve, or reject approval requests
  knowledge  Search and read knowledge articles
  records    Query any table when no specialized command fits
  setup      Connect to ServiceNow and manage profiles
  discover   Find commands by task word or table

ALL COMMANDS BY GROUP
jsn --all-commands --help for details
CORE
  knowledge  Search and read knowledge articles
  incidents  List, show, create, or update incidents
  changes    Work with change requests
  requests   Work with requested items
  tasks      Work with catalog tasks
  tickets    Query generic tickets
  slas       Inspect SLA definitions and the task SLAs on a record (read-only)
  approvals  List, approve, or reject approval requests

AUTOMATION
  flows           Manage Flow Designer flows
  actions         Flow Designer actions: create, edit full definitions, and test
                  with outputs
  scriptactions   Manage scriptactions
  scheduledjobs   Manage scheduledjobs
  triggers        Manage triggers
  events          Inspect the event log, its backlog and reprocess a recorded
                  event
  asyncrules      Manage asyncrules
  rules           Manage rules
  decisiontables  Manage decision tables
  assignments     Manage assignments
  scrapi          Manage Scripted REST APIs (list, show, create) and search
                  every REST API and its OpenAPI spec
  email           Manage email
  notifications   Explain outbound notification delivery
  restmessage     Manage restmessage
  soapmessages    Manage soapmessages

ACCESS
  access-analyzer  Inspect saved Access Analyzer requests, outcomes and checks,
                   check a user's access live, or run a live evaluation (--save
                   keeps it)
  acls             Manage acls
  b4rules          Inspect before-query business rules that can filter record
                   reads
  roles            Manage roles
  privileges       Manage privileges
  usercriteria     Manage usercriteria
  aliases          Manage aliases
  connections      Inspect HTTP connections and the credentials they use;
                   secrets are never read (read-only)
  groups           Manage ServiceNow groups
  groupmembers     Manage group memberships
  grouproles       Manage group roles
  userroles        List, grant or remove direct user roles
  users            Manage ServiceNow users

USER EXPERIENCE
  forms              Manage UI Forms
  lists              List views for a table
  clientscripts      Manage clientscripts
  uipolicies         Manage uipolicies
  uiactions          Manage uiactions
  views              Manage views
  catalogitems       Manage Service Catalog items
  catalogscripts     Manage catalogscripts
  cataloguipolicies  Manage cataloguipolicies
  uipages            Manage uipages
  uimacros           Manage uimacros
  listcontrols       Manage listcontrols
  sppages            Manage sppages
  spwidgets          Manage spwidgets
  uxscripts          Manage uxscripts
  uxlists            Manage uxlists
  uxapplicability    Manage uxapplicability
  appmenu            Manage appmenu
  appmodules         Manage appmodules

DATA
  tables         Manage tables
  columns        Manage columns
  relationships  Manage relationships
  cmdb           Query the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) — CIs and
                 relationship traversal (read-only)
  includes       Manage includes
  import         Manage import
  logs           Query system logs
  properties     Manage properties
  records        Query any table when no specialized command fits
  transactions   Summarize syslog_transaction response times by transaction type
  snippets       Save and re-run named query snippets (stored locally, no
                 instance contact except run)

CONFIGURATION
  setup        Connect to ServiceNow and manage profiles
  preferences  Configure JSN workflow opinions installation-wide or per profile
  auth         Manage authentication (OAuth, Basic, or browser session)
  updatesets   Manage update sets. Global + Default mutations require approval
               (--force only after user approval); create/set remain available
               to select a dedicated capture set. Scope mismatches warn;
               completed capture sets block writes.
  scopes       Manage application scopes
  midservers   Manage ServiceNow MID Servers and run commands through them
  platform     Inspect read-only platform health and node statistics

DEVELOPER
  scan        Instance Scan checks, suites, explicit targets, progress and
              findings
  atf         Automated Test Framework (list, suites, run, results, steps)
  eval        Execute background scripts on the instance (--repl for interactive
              mode)
  fixscripts  Manage fixscripts
  rest        Make raw REST API calls
  graphql     Execute a GraphQL document against ServiceNow Now GraphQL
  codesearch  Search code across ServiceNow artifacts with read-only GraphQL
              queries
  docs        Search ServiceNow documentation (hosted by default; configure your
              service in setup)
  document    Create bounded read-only instance configuration documentation
  diff        Compare records across configured profiles (read-only)
  perf        Capture and compare performance summaries, rank slow pattern logs,
              and explain a slow query
  skill       Manage the jsn AI agent skill file (for Hermes, Claude Code,
              Cursor, etc.)
  version     Show version information

OTHER
  app              Build a local app project into a deployable artifact, or
                   deploy the package backend to an instance
  cases            List, show or search service and HR cases visible to the
                   connected account
  workflows        Inspect legacy Workflow Editor workflows (read-only)
  attachments      List, download and upload files attached to any record
  store            Discover ServiceNow Store applications, inspect versions and
                   entitlement, and request explicit installs/updates
  plugins          Show a plugin with its nested dependencies, compare plugins
                   across instances, activate one, and read batch install plans
  compare          Compare plugins AND Store apps; report how to align --target
                   to desired --source (read-only)
  subscriptions    Inspect subscription evidence, local schedules and
                   illustrative ITOM populations
  skipped-updates  Review and process existing unresolved skipped updates across
                   all upgrade history
  customizations   Capture and compare customization evidence locally, or revert
                   an application's customised files
  upgrade          Upgrade jsn through npm (preserves the installed release
                   channel)
  discover         Find commands by task word or table

EXAMPLES
  jsn incidents list --query "active=true" --limit 5
  jsn records list --table incident --columns sys_id,number,state --limit 5 \
  --csv
  jsn discover catalog

FLAGS
  -i, --instance  ServiceNow instance URL [string]
  -p, --profile   Configuration profile to use [string]
  --json          Output in JSON format (shortcut for --format=json) [boolean]
  --csv           CSV output for compact, flat record lists [boolean]
  --tsv           TSV output for compact, tab-separated record lists [boolean]
  --help          Show help [boolean]

OUTPUT
  Bound lists with --columns and --limit.
  CSV/TSV save tokens; JSON preserves metadata and nesting.
  Use JSON for pagination or reference IDs with display labels.

NEXT
  https://jsn.jace.pro/docs/     Guides: setup, safety, output, agents, features
  jsn <command> <action> --help  Options for one command or action
  jsn discover <word>            Find commands by task words
  jsn discover --table <table>   Find commands configured for a table
  jsn --all-commands --help      Every command and global flag
  jsn --json                     Registered command surface as JSON
